confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking sites. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately grounded. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and prices vary by neighbourhood and booking date. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and lean on the typical local price relationship to beer. The FX figure comes from WebSearch result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to mid-sized Portuguese and Iberian tourist cities, set slightly below Lisbon. Accommodation reflects July high-season demand around Porto's historic centre. Cocktail and wine anchors are relationship-based on local beer pricing.
